title: Wdfy3 loss selectively suppresses synaptic and AP-1/JNK transcripts in thalamic neurons
exact_observed_result: Wdfy3 perturbation generated its only broad corrected response in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, where Stmn4 and Jun led a synaptic/AP-1 module, and the Dctn1/Sema6a/Herc2/Pten versus Grin1 neighborhood remained exploratory because whole-transcriptome correlations were modest.
biological_interpretation: WDFY3 supports a thalamic neuronal state linked to synaptic and stress transcripts rather than a simple pan-autophagy or DVL/Wnt output.

evidence_records.statistics: 371,818 Wdfy3-target rows from 22 cell types; Wdfy3 transcript was present in every contrast. The strongest Wdfy3 row was in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut: logFC -0.2089, score -3.699, p=2.16e-4, FDR=0.1065, 230 perturbed versus 23,679 controls.
evidence_records.description: Direct quantification of the target transcript after Wdfy3 perturbation.

evidence_records.statistics: 230 perturbed cells versus 23,679 controls; 17 genes at FDR<0.05, 32 at FDR<0.10, 69 at p<0.001, and 240 at p<0.01 among 17,259 tested genes; top p values were Stmn4 p=2.26e-13 FDR=3.24e-9 and Jun p=3.76e-13 FDR=3.24e-9.
evidence_records.description: The only Wdfy3 contrast with a broad transcriptome-wide response.

evidence_records.statistics: 20 of 22 Wdfy3 cell-type contrasts had zero genes at FDR<0.10; 155 MB Glut had one FDR<0.10 gene; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut had 32 FDR<0.10 genes.
evidence_records.description: Aggregate cell-type specificity of the Wdfy3 perturbation.

evidence_records.statistics: Full-transcriptome Wdfy3 score correlations: Dctn1 r=0.204, Herc2 0.189, Celf2 0.186, Pten 0.180, Grin1 -0.269, Tbce -0.181, Ptprd -0.149, Atp6v0c -0.147. Restricted to the 240 Wdfy3 p<0.01 genes, Dctn1 r=0.669, Sema6a 0.612, Herc2 0.566, Pten 0.458, and Grin1 -0.694.
evidence_records.description: Top positive and negative signature-neighbor scan for the strongest Wdfy3 cell type.

caveats: The Wdfy3 self-transcript decrease in the responsive thalamic class was nominal, so the phenotype is assigned by guides without FDR-verified Wdfy3 mRNA depletion.

prior_expectation.summary: Prior literature and pathway context were taken from the resolved report references; the observed Perturb-seq signal either refines expected gene function by cell type or marks an exploratory response-state neighbor where noted in caveats.
